review_description: We were very confident with our salesman Horst, who was very knowledgeable and effective in the quoting process.When our panels were installed they did a tidy efficient job.  Unfortunately a part was required and nearly 4 weeks later we are still waiting for our solar to be finished off,  so we can have it inspected and turned on by the relevant authorities,

The installer came on-site to do a quote, and answered all of my many questions! They kindly did multiple quotes as I was undecided on system size. The installation was very smooth and everything demonstrated to me. I would highly recommend Gnowee Solar based on my experience.

We chose Gnowee/ Green Solar because Shennal the electrician came and looked at the site as well as arial photos. We were able to get a larger system than expected at a competitive price.The install was more difficult than expected due to the age of our roof. I really liked the care they took to make sure it was done well.    The only thing I had to do was make sure I had sufficient replacement tiles for my crappy roof. (Melbourne Roof Tiling Preston are fantastic) They managed everything else.I trust them and would recommend them to family.

Very happy with how the process went - both initial quote and installation. I felt some installers were quoting a system based on their preferred products (particularly around the selection of inverters), while Gnowee (Nim) was able to provide a solution that suited our needs.The installation (led by Sam) went well - although the weather on installation day was poor and caused some delays, they were back the next morning to finish the job. We opted for a battery to provide back-up of some systems in case of a black-out and the process of working out which systems were backed up and then testing that worked went well.

Gnowee were accommodating of our needs and timeframe to re-install panels on our new property. The process was straightforward, professional and personalised. Highly recommend them for your solar needs.

After many quotes some much higher and some much lower, but all wanting full payment before starting and requesting I sign pages of legal documents, I gave up.Then I found Finn and Solarquotes. and selected Gnowee from his recommendations.No pressure quote, best type of panel for the sea side. Paid deposit on the Wed. and it was installed next day on the Thurs. and it was inspected the next Mon. and switched on, so  I paid the balance on the Wed.The system has been  running ever since.Thank you Finn
Gnowee Solar completed the 10 Kw solar installation within the agreed time frame with no problems. Very happy with the follow up.

This was an easy experience. Explained to me in terms I could get my head around. Answered all my questions in plain english. Installation was fast and efficient. Reasonably priced. Super pleased with the experience.

Nim,  from Gnowee, happily provided me with full quotes showing power production and pay back rates etc for several configurations of panels and inverters as I continued to compare all the options. Nim promptly answered all my questions.  I finally made the decision and the installation happened within a week. The installation looks incredibly neat - something I only appreciated afterwards. My system  has 29 panels and produces 12.32kw. (This wasn't an option in the section below)Nim is very punctual, tidy, polite and not at all pushy.He organised all the grid connections and connected it to the WiFi. He also helped me set up the app and showed me how to use it. Very happy with how easily and efficiently everything was done!
My installation was completed efficiently with no issue.They were punctual.

The sales and quoting process was everything we neededThe installation was done with technical expertise and professionalism.  on time and without any inconvenienceCustomer service was excellent and the technician spent extra time showing us the App for the Alph ESS
Gnowee replied to our enquiry first and a rep arrived on the same day. The rep explained the process very well and our experience confirmed the rep's account of the process.

Absolutely thrilled with the solar installation provided by Gnowee Solar From start to finish, their team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine commitment to customer satisfaction.The initial consultation was informative and transparent. They patiently answered all my questions and provided a detailed breakdown of the installation process, costs, and expected savings. This gave me confidence that I was making an informed decision.During installation, the team was efficient and respectful of my property. They completed the job on schedule and left everything clean and tidy. The quality of workmanship is excellent, and it's clear they take pride in their craft.Overall, I highly recommend Gnowee Solar to anyone considering solar energy. Their knowledgeable team, seamless process, and exceptional service have made this experience truly positive and rewarding.
Yes good assistance in all areas. Horst and Nim were very helpful
From Quotation to Solar Panel the installation process could not have been made any easier and the installers are s credit to the  Gnowee Company. .
Sales were friendly and helpful, explained everything and gave me options to match my use case.The installers were friendly, they got the job done fast and everything looks perfect.

The whole process of purchasing solar was a breeze with Gnowee solar. Quote was quick and very competitive. Installation was completed within 5 days of the quote. Customer service was 10/10, and is currently organising my meter upgrade with the power company.
Incredible customer service, very quick to respond to my concerns and extremely intelligent workers. Workers were very polite, friendly, and clean. Thanks so much for the great effort.
Horst from Gnowee was lovely and very patientI wasn’t there for the installation. But I believe all went wellGnowee helped with all the paperwork and all has gone smoothly so far

The sales person was excellent unit I requested a consideration on the installation price due to a different system being installedI had a quotation for a 3 strings 3,4,5.setup in 2 different locations on the roof to avoid trees shading causing lower delivery of powerI received a 2x6  set up in one location instead without my permission or any consultingThe installation was perfect but the salesman was insulting when he told me I was cheeky requesting a discount due to less wiring requirements and labourHe has not contacted me since the installation to see how I feel or how the job went only to say the installation team have the final say about the panels layout. I would have appreciated support to set up my Fronius monitoring program

Sales and quoting was very good and understandableThe installation went perfectly - came on time  no slackness near and tidy respectful and was helpful when questions weee askedCustomer service was the best -  helpful respectful at all times -Explained how it worked and also advised and showed me my damaged power board that other electrians over the past months/years  should have picked up on as it was dangerous.Extremely happy with Repersentive and the installers.

Apart from still waiting 12 days after installation for the inspector to turn the system on, Gnowee were exceptional. Horst explained everything we needed to know. His patience in taking us through the process was most appreciated. The installation process with Shennal and his team went smoothly. Assuming my system gets turned on this week,  I am very pleased with Gnowee, and I highly recommend them.
They started my system and never finished it.Edit 24/2/2023: The system is now installed but not how the original quote stated and not how I wanted.

Gnowee solar we're great to deal with. Horst based in Mornington was very helpful & honest and very informative. He came out to our house and assed the site and took us through the process. They organised all connection to the grid for us which was great.  I would definitely recommend Gnowee Solar if your looking to go ahead with Solar.
GreatGood all round serviceWould recommend to anyone that wants a good hassle free system
Hasn’t been installed yet but best explanation by seller and down to earth approach

Gnowee Solar was not the only company we received quotes from for our solar energy system but they were certainly the most professional and stood out from the others. Warnie attended our site in person, designed our solar system and we were very impressed with the level of information, knowledge and potential savings he provided to us with his quotation submission. He was always very pleasant and accommodating to our needs and was able to answer any enquiries promptly. The installation was done with little disruption and the installers very professional, hard working and clean. Rubbish was removed when the job was completed and the installation thoroughly inspected by Warnie upon completion. Gnowee then submitted all relevant documents for connection to the grid in a very timely manner. After having dealt with Gnowee Solar from start to finish, I absolutely highly recommend them for your solar needs.

The salesman was polite, patient, informative and always available for follow-up phone calls.The installation was efficient, tidy and punctual.The company was very helpful in organizing the connection to the grid.

Very simple & fast process - should have done it years ago.  Fantastic knowledge and service from Horst who answered all my questions openly and honestly without arrogance or showmanship.  Install was done in a day with no issues - very polite and easy going installers.  Using the free PowerPal app supplied by the government (I can’t work out how to use the Inverter app - too complicated)  I can see we’ve already halved our weekly energy usage from the grid.  Looking forward to seeing how much we’ve saved on our next electricity bill.

I wanted a premium system and thought sunpower macron was the way to go. With tons of reviews from this website and others I appreciate there are many views on the subject. I ended going with rec alpha panels and a fronious inverter and was very happy with the service from gnowee solar. They were not able to supply the originally quoted panels but made a fair compromise on the alternative.     The best thing was that I was was fussy about the source of the panels as I am not happy to support countries with trade sanctions against Australia. Another reputable company in our area did not listen as well and this proved to be the deciding factor.The dreaded Covid hit on our original very prompt installation date and the reschedule was quickly arranged.On the whole a great result.

Totally smooth process, sales person was the only one to come to site to quote and was great and available to take my calls at any time and communicated exceptionally well and quick to respond. Would recommend these guys to anyone else looking for Solar solutions.
Also very happy with solarquotes - thank you. Very pleased with the service , communication and explanations from the team and after sales responses to questions.

Gnowee was great start to finish. Easy to communicate with. All options presented were clear and easy to understand. Great customer service.  Installation booked quickly and ran smoothly. Further follow-up onsite was detailed and personalised, giving me greater confidence I had chosen the right company.

We had several quotes and two excellent sales representatives from different companies who were always willing to explain cost/benefit ratios, processes and products.Our final selection was based on the ability of the sales person to respond to our questions and uncertainties.The whole process was easy; the service was prompt and efficient and all communications were timely and efficient.We are extremely happy with our choice and our solar system.
Thank you Warnie and team for professional  consulting and solar panel and battery installation. Your team was very helpful in providing all the needed information.Highly recommend !
Excellent service and follow up. Installation is due next week.

Was very happy with the job Gnowee did. We had two systems installed as we have two separate dwellings. The customer service was exceptional. A great product at a reasonable price. Salesman Warnie was lovely and very knowledgeable. Installation was done within a day, they turned up when they said they would. They helped organise the grid connection.

In addition to the 3 quotes through solarquotes, I got a fair few more, and had been doing some general research for a while.  Overall the costs are pretty similar between companies when you have an idea about what panels/inverter. So for me it came down to what company I felt I could trust to do a good job.Hence why I went with Gnowee Solar. I found that Horst was easily the most accommodating person to deal with out of the various companies. He was not pushy, understood exactly what he was doing, and happy to adjust the setup multiple times. There were a few minor issues related to the computer software not showing the roof accurately which made it difficult to determine the maximum number of panels I could fit, and this was identified on installation day. However issues happen and the most important thing is that they were quickly managed.The installation is great and of very high quality. It was a fairly large system by usual residential standards (9.36kw) and I am very happy with the result.I appreciate all the effort. thanks.
Excellent service and great system, could not be happier with our decision
They were great, all went smoothly very professional and knowledgeable.
Quoting process was very easy to understand as the consultant takes his time without any rude.Installer was very polite and punctual.The installer did the grid connection.

Overall a very good experience with Gnowee. All involved were very professional, knowledgeable and arranged the installation and then all connections promptly. We even had Worksafe come out unexpectedly during installation for a site check without any issues.

Panels were put into a position that didn't allow access to guttering even though there was plenty of space on the roof.  Credit to Gnowee Solar though, they sent the installers back to move the panels and repair the tiles they broke.
We got our system installed and are loving it and are getting credit bills every month.
Installed a 65kw system with Gnowee. We are very happy with the installation, very professionally done. The installation was very neatly done. Would highly recommend this company to anyone.

Gnowee Solar provided a professional service in the installation of our solar panels. The process was simple and it was a hassle free experience. Extremely happy with these guys. Thanks to them our last five bills were in credit!

Gnowee Solar rep in Melbourne was recommended by family friends.
